baseline_models.mechanism: The verse opens a two-pole self-classification into a larger field of routes. Soundness supplies the positive pole, duna marks positions short of it, and the path/party branches make the remainder internally multiple rather than one undifferentiated bad class.

activation_trace.role: Soundness against corruption establishes the positive pole of the classification.
Nearness short of a limit makes the contrast gradable rather than simply binary.
Extended ways turn moral positions into courses that can be followed.
Diverging paths and parties expands the second pole into distinct groups and opinions.

changed_reading.before: Some of the jinn are righteous and the rest are otherwise.
changed_reading.after: The speakers locate themselves in a ranked but internally plural social field: sound members stand at one pole, while multiple other parties occupy differing routes and degrees short of it.

baseline_models.mechanism: Track-following-track joined to lengthwise cutting gives the plurality a material topology. The ways are not merely a list of opinions; repeated traces and longitudinal splits produce separate channels through a shared field, while kunna presents that configuration as a temporally established condition.

activation_trace.role: Temporal being presents the route configuration as an established state.
One track following another supplies repeated linear traces through the collective.
Lengthwise splitting turns repeated traces into materially separated channels.

changed_reading.before: The jinn held a variety of views.
changed_reading.after: Their history had been scored into durable longitudinal courses: plurality is a produced spatial structure, not only an inventory of beliefs.

baseline_models.mechanism: The reconciliation branch of salaha meets the party-splitting branch of qadda. This permits a functional reading of the salihun as people who remove estrangement and restore relations from within a collective already divided into parties.

activation_trace.role: Reconciliation supplies an active social function for the salihun, not only private virtue.
Separated parties provide the fractured social field in which reconciliation operates.

changed_reading.before: The salihun are simply the morally good subgroup.
changed_reading.after: The salihun may also be the cohesion-producing subgroup whose soundness is shown by repairing relations among divergent parties.

context_deltas.mechanism: The temporal force of kunna is reread against 72:13's hearing-to-belief sequence. The divergent tracks can be the remembered configuration from which the speakers respond to newly received guidance, not necessarily their permanent post-hearing taxonomy.

activation_trace.role: Temporal predication makes the focus plurality available as a prior or background state.
Extended ways are the inherited courses from which a response can depart.
Divergent parties identify the plural pre-response configuration.
Hearing as understanding and compliance makes reception an event that can alter a route.
Gentle indication toward the path supplies the directional intervention into prior plurality.
Heart-settling affirmation supplies the changed response after guidance is heard.

structural_cues: 72:13 follows the focus with an explicit when-heard-then-believed sequence.
The focus uses kunna, while 72:13 shifts to eventive sami'na and amanna.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies temporal kana and a later hearing-to-belief sequence; I infer a before/after relation, while the live alternative is that kunna reports a plurality that continues after belief.

changed_reading.before: The divergent ways form a static description of the community.
changed_reading.after: The verse can be retrospective testimony about inherited divergence just before guidance reorganizes the speakers' trajectories.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated 'among us ... and among us ...' frame in 72:14 revoices the focus classification with surrender/safety, deviation, and sought right direction. The focus plurality therefore becomes ethically consequential response-branching without requiring a one-to-one equation between salihun and muslimun.

activation_trace.role: Soundness provides the focus verse's positive category.
Other-than supplies the open second category that the later echo can sharpen.
Divergent parties make the classification a branching social structure.
Safety from defect gives the later positive branch a condition of wholeness.
Deviation and leaning from right supplies the adverse response branch.
Straightness of path gives the repeated partition an explicit directional criterion.

structural_cues: 72:14 repeats the focus syntax: wa-anna minna ... wa-minna ... .
72:14 follows its two groups with an explicit result clause about seeking rushd.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an unusually close syntactic echo and path-straightness imagery; I treat it as a normative reclassification, while preserving the alternative that the two pairs overlap only partially.

changed_reading.before: The focus neutrally reports several social or doctrinal groupings.
changed_reading.after: The later echo exposes the plurality as response trajectories with unequal direction: some move toward wholeness and right direction, while others lean away.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus pairing of reconciliation with split parties is reinforced by 72:14: salm contributes peacemaking, while the qist inventory contributes scattered groups. The salihun can thus be read as agents counteracting the community's centrifugal organization.

activation_trace.role: Removing estrangement gives salihun a relational repair function.
Diverging parties define the division that requires repair.
Peace and reconciliation repeat the social-cohesion image in the later positive group.
Scattered groups intensify the image of a collective pulling apart.

structural_cues: The two 'among us' constructions place positive and adverse groups inside one speaking collective.
The focus names division immediately after naming the salihun.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two reconciliation branches and two party/scatter branches; I infer a repair-versus-dispersion mechanism, while the alternative is that these are moral labels with no assigned communal function.

changed_reading.before: Reading salihun as reconcilers is only a possible focus-root nuance.
changed_reading.after: The later partition strengthens a social-organizational reading: sound members resist the scattering generated by divergent parties.

context_deltas.mechanism: The singular path of 72:16 becomes straight and is followed by abundant watering. Read beside the focus's extended ways and lengthwise cuts, the plural routes become channel-like conduits whose alignment governs whether provision can flow through the partitioned field.

activation_trace.role: Fitness or suitability lets soundness describe a route capable of carrying its intended flow.
Extended ways supply the conduits in the focus verse.
Lengthwise cutting supplies the channel-forming partition.
Straightness and even alignment define the condition imposed on the path.
The singular extended path concentrates the focus's plural routes into a tested alignment.
A share and channel of irrigation makes the path-to-water relation infrastructural.
Abundant water and provision identifies what an aligned channel conveys.

structural_cues: 72:16 uses a conditional straightening of the singular al-tariqah followed by la-asqaynahum.
The water result immediately follows the community classifications of 72:11-15.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies straight path, irrigation-channel, and abundant-water images; I infer a hydraulic relation to the focus's lengthwise cuts, while the live alternative is that water is generic provision and the path remains solely ethical.

changed_reading.before: The routes merely name sectarian opinions.
changed_reading.after: The routes also function like conduits: their fitness and alignment determine whether abundance can move through a divided collective.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus duna recurs in 72:22 beside multahadan, whose branches describe leaning toward a side refuge. This closes the topology: the community may contain many lower, other, or diverging routes, but none becomes an ultimate lateral exit from divine reach.

activation_trace.role: Other-than opens the focus classification beyond the salihun.
Extended routes provide the network in which an apparent side exit could be imagined.
Diverging parties supply real internal branching without guaranteeing escape.
Besides or other than recurs in the denial of any alternate refuge.
Leaning toward a refuge supplies the blocked lateral movement through the route network.

structural_cues: The same d-w-n root appears in the focus contrast and in 72:22's denial of refuge.
Multahadan immediately follows min dunihi, coupling otherness with a sideward refuge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated d-w-n and a refuge reached by leaning aside; I infer closure of the focus route network, while the alternative is that 72:22 states theology without qualifying 72:11's social plurality.

changed_reading.before: Each divergent way can be imagined as an independent exit or destination.
changed_reading.after: The plurality consists of internal routes and statuses within one inescapable field; no side branch is an ultimate refuge.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing sequence places watch along a road, then asserts complete encompassing and exhaustive counting. The focus's divergent tracks and parties no longer suggest disorder opaque to oversight; they become bounded lanes whose differences remain individually legible.

activation_trace.role: Track following track supplies distinguishable lanes rather than an undifferentiated mass.
Divergent parties identify the units whose plurality must remain legible.
A watch-post or watched road puts observation directly onto route space.
Complete encompassing in knowledge supplies the outer bound around every route.
Exhaustive enumeration makes each differentiated unit accountable.
Counting the counted closes the mechanism with discrete, retained distinctions.

structural_cues: 72:27 places surveillance before and behind the messenger.
72:28 joins encompassing, exhaustive reckoning, totality, and number in one close.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a watched-road branch and explicit closure/counting; I infer that the focus parties remain separately traceable, while the alternative is that the closing oversight concerns messengers only and does not extend to the jinn's routes.

changed_reading.before: Fragmentation makes the collective look dispersed and opaque.
changed_reading.after: Its divergent routes are bounded and enumerable: differentiation persists, but no party or trajectory disappears from complete oversight.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses from social paths into textile work. It remains anchored by qidada's explicit cut-cloth branch and yasluku's explicit sewing-thread branch; downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for routing divided units, not as the lexical translation of either verse.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: qidada as cut material within tara'iq qidada

activation_trace.role: Layer over layer supplies a fabric-like arrangement of the focus routes.
Cut leather, meat, or cloth turns qidada into separated material strips.
Sewing thread supplies a means by which separated material is routed into an ordered line.

changed_reading.before: Divergence is only rupture into separate parties.
changed_reading.after: As an exploratory material model, the collective is cut into strips that can still be threaded into directed outcomes; division creates routable units as well as rupture.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it hears a musical branch of t-r-q inside an ordinary path expression. It remains anchored to tara'iq and is activated by the packet's hearing and recitation sequence; downstream prose should call it a sonic model of plural testimony, never a claim that tara'iq literally means melodies here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: tara'iq as distinct strokes within the plural speaker's testimony

activation_trace.role: A separate musical stroke converts each route into a distinct audible line.
Divergent parties preserve distinct voices within the collective first-person plural.
Auditory perception activates a sonic rather than solely spatial organization of the ways.
Recitation supplies the sounded event to which the plural voices respond.

changed_reading.before: The jinn describe a map of separate social routes.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, their first-person testimony is polyphonic: distinct strokes or lines disclose internal plurality after a shared act of hearing.

strongest_changes: Kunna plus the hearing-to-belief sequence makes the focus plurality readable as a prior configuration undergoing reorientation.
The repeated 'among us' syntax in 72:14 turns open diversity into ethically unequal response trajectories while leaving the category mapping non-identical.
The straight-path/water and final watch/enumeration sequences make divergent ways function as aligned or misaligned conduits that remain bounded and legible.
summary.what_was_special: The focus itself fuses moral rank, social parties, extended tracks, and lengthwise cutting. Context then reuses that topology through syntactic reclassification, hydraulic flow, blocked lateral refuge, watched roads, and exhaustive counting, allowing several causal models to coexist without collapsing the paths into one metaphor.
remaining_uncertainties: Kunna may mark a completed pre-guidance state or merely background a plurality that continues.
The hydraulic and textile mechanisms may be explanatory analogies rather than semantic force in the focus wording.
The salihun/other partition and the muslimun/qasitun partition may overlap without mapping one-to-one.
